SELECT inv_mast.item_id,
    po_hdr.supplier_id,
    supplier.supplier_name,
    po_hdr.po_no,
    po_hdr.order_date,
    CAST(po_line.qty_ordered / po_line.unit_size  AS Decimal(19,9)) qty_ordered,
    CAST(po_line.qty_received / po_line.unit_size  AS Decimal(19,9)) qty_received,
    po_line.unit_of_measure,
    po_line.unit_price,
    po_line.received_date,
    po_line.cancel_flag,
    po_line.complete,
    po_hdr.location_id,
    COALESCE(po_line.line_type, po_hdr.po_type) po_type,
    CASE po_hdr.po_type
    WHEN 'Q' THEN
    'Y'
    ELSE
    'N'
    END cc_isRFQ,
    COALESCE(vessel_receipts.sum_qty_on_vessel, 0) / po_line.unit_size AS qty_on_vessel
    ,po_line.unit_price_display  /*MAIN FROM CLAUSE*/
    FROM po_hdr
    INNER JOIN po_line ON po_line.po_no = po_hdr.po_no
    INNER JOIN supplier ON supplier.supplier_id = po_hdr.supplier_id
    LEFT JOIN vendor_rfq_hdr ON vendor_rfq_hdr.po_hdr_uid = po_hdr.po_hdr_uid
    INNER JOIN inv_mast ON inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = po_line.inv_mast_uid
    LEFT JOIN  (
    SELECT  SUM(vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_received - vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_unloaded) AS sum_qty_on_vessel,
    vessel_receipts_line.po_line_uid
    FROM vessel_receipts_line (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN vessel_receipts_hdr (NOLOCK) ON vessel_receipts_hdr.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid = vessel_receipts_line.vessel_receipts_hdr_uid
    WHERE (vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_received - vessel_receipts_line.container_qty_unloaded) > 0
    AND vessel_receipts_line.row_status_flag = 702
    AND vessel_receipts_hdr.row_status_flag = 972
    GROUP BY vessel_receipts_line.po_line_uid
    ) AS vessel_receipts ON vessel_receipts.po_line_uid = po_line.po_line_uid
    /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/
    WHERE inv_mast.item_id = :as_item_id
    AND po_hdr.location_id in (:ala_location_id)
    AND ( (po_hdr.po_type <> 'Q') OR (po_hdr.po_type = 'Q' AND po_line.delete_flag = 'N' AND
    po_line.complete = 'N' AND  po_line.cancel_flag = 'N' AND
    DATEADD(day, 1, vendor_rfq_hdr.expiration_date) >=
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
    /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/
